note: 2022 MCM A, team 2212245. 21 figure rows (20 numbered plus the uncaptioned leaflet chart on p24) and 7 measured tables over 36 regions, with 8 exclusions, all of them composite panels. Three exhibit shapes need reading before the fields make sense: Figure 13 and Figure 14 are three-element composites that print only two panel letters - (a) an embedded third-party course map, (b) a line-art outline with an unlabelled elevation inset - so the row bounds the outline and the raster and the profile are fragments; Figure 15 is one three-panel composite split across pages 17 and 18 with its caption printed only under (b)/(c); and Figure 18 is two different chart types under one caption, a polar plot and a line chart. Seven pages carry no region at all (1, 2, 7, 12, 13, 22, 23); a page-level audit confirms they hold only prose, display mathematics, the contents page and the bibliography, so the empty verdict is correct there rather than a miss. The last two pages are not an appendix: p24 opens a 'Rider's Race Guidance' leaflet addressed to the directeur sportif and carries a fully annotated four-series power chart with no caption and no number, and p25 is bare text that ends mid-list with no references section and no closing matter - the bibliography is on p23 and the table of contents mislocates it. Printing errors kept verbatim rather than corrected: Figure 13's caption says Female over a map whose banner says Men; Figure 16's caption is a copy of Figure 12's; Figure 20's caption says individual time trial over a team-rotation drawing; the p20 velocity axis is labelled m*s^-3; and the two prose pointers that introduce Tables 2 and 3 call them 'Table. 4' and 'Table. 5'. Section attribution defect: the printed heading '7.3 Sensitivity Analysis of the deviations from the target power' on p18 is missing from the extractor's heading index, so the two p18 rows carry that heading's text verbatim and the label is accepted from the printed text layer instead of the index.
rules: Figure captions sit below their artwork and table captions above the grid on all 27 printed rows, and the only exhibit that breaks the rule is the leaflet chart, which has no caption at all [caption.position].
The family mix splits into three blocks: line 9, flowchart-or-schematic 6, composite-panel 4, map-or-plan-view 1, photo-or-raster-image 1, plus 7 table-grids [geometry.family].

Nothing in the paper is three-dimensional and nothing carries a colour bar: the four composites encode depth and magnitude with colour bands, arrows and stacked panels instead [geometry.three_d] [geometry.colorbar].

Sections 3.1 to 3.3 are pure schematics - one single-panel diagram per subsection, meaning carried by edge colour plus inline words, never by a legend - and the only photograph in the paper sits in the introduction [geometry.family] [geometry.legend].

Every power-profile figure is a pair of panels, linear time beside log time, sharing one power axis, with the legend inside the frame; Figures 6 and 7 repeat the legend in both panels while Figures 8 and 9 put it in the left panel only [geometry.panel_layout] [geometry.legend].

Section 7 repeats one composite recipe twice: panel (a) is an embedded third-party course map with its own banner and key, panel (b) is a thin line-art outline plus an unlabelled elevation-profile inset, and the caption covers the whole thing with only (a)/(b) labelled [geometry.family] [geometry.panel_count].

Every table is booktabs with three rules, one header row, no vertical rules and no zebra; four of the seven tables fit in half the measure - the two parameter blocks and the two characteristic-power grids - while the two result tables and the notation glossary need the full width [table.rule_style] [table.width].

Units are placed by table size: the two one-row result tables put the unit in the header ('Time(min)', 'Time(s)'), the two characteristic-power tables fold it into a merged stub cell ('Power/Watt*kg^-1'), and the two parameter tables carry no unit at all [table.units_in_header] [table.merged_cells].

Citation spelling is inconsistent: eleven pointers use the abbreviation 'Fig.' and four use the full 'Figure', one of them with a stray article ('In the Figure 18'), and no sentence anywhere opens with 'Figure N shows' [mention.style] [mention.lead_pattern].

Caption strings are not trustworthy: Figure 16 repeats Figure 12's caption word for word for a different chart, Figure 20's caption says individual time trial over a team-rotation drawing, and Figure 13's caption says Female while the embedded map says Men [caption.verbatim] [caption.numbering].

Numbering is off by one in the tables: the sentence above Table 2 calls it 'Table. 4' and the sentence above Table 3 calls it 'Table. 5', so the printed numbers and the grids do not line up until Table 6 [mention.count] [caption.numbering].
